# BISCS India

> BISCS India (biscsindia.com) offers 149 free online tools that run entirely in the web browser, so files are never uploaded. Tools cover PDF editing and conversion, GST and income tax calculators for India, image and AI photo editing, video and audio, office documents, design, and SEO/GEO/AEO. Made by BISCS India, Kolkata, West Bengal.

Contact: info@biscsindia.com. Free to use, no sign-up. Guides explain how each tool works and when to use it. Social: https://www.linkedin.com/in/biscs-india-7a0ab03a6, https://www.facebook.com/share/1PyhN1vLey/, https://www.instagram.com/biscsindia/.
